description: List the account's Calendar user settings (time zone, locale, week start, default event length, hide weekends, format options); read-only, as Google offers no settings write (GET users/me/settings; scope calendar.settings.readonly). Runs as a background job: dispatch returns job_id/status queued at once; completion carries the vendor response (plus next_page_token/next_sync_token when Google returns them) and names the account used. API-wide query arguments: alt (json), fields (partial-response selector), pretty_print (boolean), quota_user and user_ip (deprecated). Arguments key/access_token/oauth_token are declared only to refuse credential overrides: credentials belong to the Google account contract; select credentials with account.
embedding_description: Read all of the connected user's personal Google Calendar settings at once: time zone, locale, week start day, default event length, 24-hour time format, hide weekends and declined events. Read-only; Google exposes no API to change settings.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job for the Google Calendar calendar settings listing (GET users/me/settings).
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: an argument does not match the vendor's Calendar API shape (unknown name, wrong type, missing required, value not allowed) or the session context is missing. gsuite.not_connected: no Google account linked. gsuite.unknown_account: 'account' names no connected account. gsuite.missing_scope: the account's grant lacks the Calendar scope this verb needs. gsuite.permission_denied: the account lacks access to that calendar or event. gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist or is not visible. gsuite.rate_limited: Google rate limit. gsuite.api_error: job creation failed or another Google error. gsuite.sync_token_expired: Google invalidated the sync token (410).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: correct the named argument (snake_case names; pass the vendor request object as body). gsuite.not_connected or gsuite.missing_scope: run start_interface then connect_account and approve the Calendar permissions. gsuite.unknown_account: use an email or alias from the connected accounts. gsuite.not_found: list first to get a valid id. gsuite.rate_limited: retry later with backoff. gsuite.sync_token_expired: list again without sync_token from the first page and keep the new next_sync_token.
